title: dam add document
description: What dam add prints with --json or --toon: each change it staged. A waiting item it took is staged as the change of the token that sent it. Adding a removal item also stages, as your own, the changes dam rm makes to other tasks; removed names them.

descendants.description: Children moved up to its own path.

dependents.description: Tasks that no longer depend on it.

attached.description: Tasks still attached to the removed event.
